screenLevelIssues.explanation: The React Native file for this screen was not found in the input. Cannot perform pixel-perfect analysis without existing code. Please ensure the file exists.

layoutIssues.explanation: Figma 'Frame 2095586452' (Cards Section) requires a horizontal ScrollView. The container has `paddingLeft: 64` and `paddingRight: 32` with `gap: 16` between items. This layout is critical for the 'peeking' card effect.
The 'Add Payment' button (Frame 2095586312) uses a Linear Gradient fill and a colored shadow (`#995C41`). Requires `LinearGradient` component and careful shadow implementation.

feedback.explanation: Structural analysis detected 9 text nodes (including 'All-time Total', 'Cashback Rate', 'Due in 28 Days', 'Time', and 'SELECTED') that are centered in Figma but lack 'textAlign: center' in React Native. This causes visual misalignment.
feedback.currentCode: /* Text styles for stats, headers, and labels */
feedback.fixedCode: textAlign: 'center' // Add to styles for: 'All-time Total', 'Cashback Rate', 'Due in 28 Days', 'Time', 'SELECTED'

feedback.explanation: The cards section (Frame 2095586452) requires a horizontal ScrollView to achieve the 'peeking' card effect defined in Figma.
feedback.fixedCode:
<ScrollView 
  horizontal 
  showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
  contentContainerStyle={{
    paddingLeft: spacing.huge, // 64px
    paddingRight: spacing.xl,  // 32px
    gap: spacing.md            // 16px
  }}
>

feedback.explanation: The 'Add Payment' button uses a Linear Gradient fill in Figma. Replace solid background color with LinearGradient component.
feedback.fixedCode:
// Wrap button content in LinearGradient
<LinearGradient colors={[colors.brand[400], colors.brand[600]]} ... >
